channel.title: Olive blog
channel.description: Guides and explainers on Olive, connected DeFi and the CLV to OLV migration.

item.title: What is the CLV token? Clover's token, explained
item.description: CLV is the token behind Clover Finance and the CLV chain. Here is its role, the networks it lives on, and how it connects to LUX and OLV today.

item.title: What is Olive? The successor to Clover, explained
item.description: Olive is the successor to Clover Finance and Lucent Network, built around a wallet and four connected capabilities. Here is what it offers and who it is for.

item.title: What is connected DeFi? Access, swaps and risk
item.description: Connected DeFi is one access layer for supported networks, protocols and opportunities, built on a wallet. Here is what it covers and where the risk sits.

item.title: What is agentic trading? Authorised agents explained
item.description: Agentic trading means authorised agents act on a strategy within limits you set. Here is what you configure, what they can do, and who keeps authority.

item.title: RWA tokenization and portfolio oversight, explained
item.description: Tokenized real-world assets come with product-specific terms. Here is what access means, how oversight works, and why access is not ownership.

item.title: Quantitative investing in DeFi: data, models and risk
item.description: Quantitative investing uses data and models to evaluate opportunities. Here is what it means in DeFi, what the Olive product describes, and where limits are.

item.title: Olive successor to Clover: what it means for holders
item.description: Olive is the successor to Clover and Lucent, adopted by a new team. Here is what that word means, what changes, and what stays the same for holders.

item.title: Lucent Network mainnet: what launched in 2025
item.description: Lucent launched its mainnet in July 2025 on the Solana Virtual Machine, with LUX as its token. Here is what launched and what it meant for CLV holders.

item.description: A single-chain wallet keeps one network simple. Connected DeFi adds reach and complexity. Here is the comparison, without the infrastructure detail.

item.title: CLV vs LUX vs OLV: the three tokens explained
item.description: Three tokens, three stages. CLV, LUX and OLV belong to different chapters of the same project, and each has its own network and path. Here is the comparison.

item.title: CLV to OLV migration: what holders need to know
item.description: Olive is the successor to Clover Finance. All CLV holders can migrate to OLV, with no deadline set. Here is what the migration covers and how to start.

item.title: CLV migration status: open, no deadline, all holders
item.description: The Olive migration is open for CLV and LUX holders, with no deadline set as of 19 November 2026. Here is the current status and what to verify.

item.title: CLV migration scams: official links and red flags

item.description: A step by step checklist for the CLV to OLV migration, from checking the official link to recording the transaction and confirming your OLV balance.
